kind: Actual repository Live2D ZIP validator, preview utility, and runtime browser inspection
limits: This standalone harness does not test AIRI model storage, Electron selection, stage persistence, motions, physics, or speech timing.
Browser distributions use the exact installed package versions. Imports share their real globals.
Runtime effect checks cover requested parameter boundaries. Only explicitly supplied named states add intermediate or combined-state coverage.
A non-empty render requires visual review of the saved PNGs.

sources.purpose: SDK breath disabling behavior reference, not the full AIRI motion-plugin runtime

animation.disableMethod: delete internal.breath, matching disableLive2DSdkBreath in the recorded repository source
limits: Idle phase uses the original ZIP motion with the SDK breath pass disabled.
Groups blink control stops Idle and disables automatic Idle scheduling in memory only.
AIRI motion plugins, expression preferences, storage, and full application stage are not exercised by this standalone utility harness.
